# GitHub Copilot instructions

The repository's AI policy and project rules are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. It applies to Copilot chat, the Copilot coding agent, and Copilot code review. Read and follow it. Path-specific rules are in [.github/instructions/](instructions/).

Do not add project rules to this file. Update AGENTS.md so that every AI tool gets the same rules.
